visual_board.render_contract: The model column shows which of the two strictly historical same-waypoint context candidates has higher recalled-feature cosine. It is neither a global nearest-neighbor claim nor RGB generation.

global_nearest_write_diagnostic.render_contract: model recall is visualized as the nearest earlier write RGB under recalled DINO cosine; it is not an RGB decoder output
